question: What is the average GPA of CS students?
goldSql: SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM students WHERE major = 'CS'

question: Which student has the highest GPA?
goldSql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many students are in each major? Ignore students without a major.
goldSql: SELECT major, COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY major

question: Which courses does the Math department offer?
goldSql: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE dept = 'Math'

question: How many enrollments were there in Fall 2025?
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE term = 'Fall 2025'

question: What is the average grade in Intro to Databases?
goldSql: SELECT AVG(e.grade) FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.cid = e.cid WHERE c.title = 'Intro to Databases'

question: Which students are not enrolled in any course?
goldSql: SELECT s.name FROM students s LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.sid = s.sid WHERE e.sid IS NULL

question: Which course has the most enrollments?
goldSql: SELECT c.title FROM courses c JOIN enrollments e ON e.cid = c.cid GROUP BY c.title ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of the students enrolled in Genetics.
goldSql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.sid = s.sid JOIN courses c ON c.cid = e.cid WHERE c.title = 'Genetics'

question: How many students have no GPA recorded?
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE gpa IS NULL

question: How many students have a GPA of at least 3.9?
goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE gpa >= 3.9
